diagnostic_evidence.quote: The term containing $F$ is treated in the same manner as the corresponding term in Corollary \ref{CorStrichWave}.

issues.failure_explanation: For W_n = e^{n\tau A}(f,g)+\sum_{k=0}^n e^{(n-k)\tau A}(0,F_k), the triangle inequality applied termwise with the homogeneous discrete Strichartz estimate gives \|\pi_{\tau^{-1}}w_n\|_{\ell^p_{\tau,T}L^q} \lesssim_{p,q,T} \|f\|_{H^1}+\|g\|_{L^2}+\sum_{k=0}^N\|F_k\|_{L^2} = \|f\|_{H^1}+\|g\|_{L^2}+\tau^{-1}\|F\|_{\ell^1_{\tau,T}L^2}, and the factor \tau^{-1} is sharp: taking (f,g)=0 and F_k=\delta_{k0}F_0 with F_0 a single Fourier mode at frequency |k_0|=\tau^{-1}, \|F_0\|_{L^2}=1, the first component is w_n=n\tau\operatorname{sinc}(n\tau|k_0|)F_0, and \|\pi_{\tau^{-1}}w_n\|_{\ell^6_{\tau,T}L^9} \approx T^{1/6}\tau^{5/6} (since \|w_n\|_{L^9}\sim\tau|\sin(n\tau|k_0|)|), whereas the stated right-hand side equals \|F\|_{\ell^1_{\tau,T}L^2}=\tau. The ratio blows up like \tau^{-1/6} as \tau\to0, so no T-dependent constant can rescue the displayed inequality. The proof's claim that the F-term is handled 'in the same manner' as the continuous Corollary CorStrichWave is invalid: the discrete sum lacks the averaging structure of the continuous Duhamel integral, and the per-term Strichartz bound is sharp as the example shows.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Insert the factor \tau^{-1} in front of \|F\|_{\ell^1_{\tau,T}L^2} in the statement (equivalently, put the factor \tau inside the sum in the definition of W_n). The corrected estimate follows immediately from the per-term homogeneous discrete Strichartz bound and the triangle inequality, and the use in Lemma LemDiscrWellp requires no change.
issues.overall_effect: The statement of Corollary CorDisStrichWave is false as written. Its only application, eq:StrangdiskrWellp1 in the proof of Lemma LemDiscrWellp, is unaffected: the scheme's discrete Duhamel sum carries the factor \tau inside F_k=\tau c_kG(\Pi U_k), so \tau^{-1}\|F\|_{\ell^1_{\tau}L^2} equals exactly the \|g(\pi_{\tau^{-1}}u_n)\|_{\ell^1_\tau([0,t_j],L^2)}+\tau\|g(\pi_{\tau^{-1}}u_{j+1})\|_{L^2} displayed there. Hence no downstream formal result is invalidated.
issues.title: Discrete inhomogeneous Strichartz estimate (CorDisStrichWave) is false as stated: missing factor tau^{-1} on the source term
issues.why_classification: The defect is a single missing factor in one displayed estimate; the correction is forced, local, and routine, and the only downstream use already coincides with the corrected statement, so every claim, rate, and guarantee survives and no dependent result is affected.

issues.failure_explanation: The exact error satisfies E_n^K=e^{n\tau A}E_0^K+\Pi_K\int_0^{t_n}e^{(n\tau-s)A}G(U(s))ds-\tau\sum_{k=0}^nc_ke^{(n-k)\tau A}\mathcal I_KG(\Pi_{\tau^{-1}}U^K_k). After the B\tilde/D\tilde split, the remaining bracket is \Pi_KG(\Pi_NU(t_k))-\mathcal I_KG(\Pi_{\tau^{-1}}U^K_k), which equals the paper's \tilde Q_n+\Pi_K\tilde P_n integrand only after adding two further terms that the proof neither displays nor estimates: (M1) \tau\sum c_ke^{(n-k)\tau A}(I-\Pi_K)G(\Pi_NU(t_k)), the projection tail of the nonlinearity at the grid points (nonzero when \alpha N>K, i.e. N=K), and (M2) \tau\sum c_ke^{(n-k)\tau A}\mathcal I_K[G(\Pi_{\tau^{-1}}U^K_k)-G(\Pi_NU^K_k)], the difference of temporal filters on the numerical solution. Both are controllable: \|(I-\pi_K)g(u)\|_{L^2}\lesssim_M K^{-1} by localizing the tail of the convolution \hat u^{*\alpha} beyond K/\alpha in \ell^1 (and \|g(\pi_Nu)-g(u)\|_{L^1_TL^{6/5}}\lesssim N^{-1} by Lemma LemStrichg(u)), giving M1\lesssim_{M,T}(K^{-1}+\tau); and M2 is absorbed by the stability estimates of Lemmas LemStabStrang3/LemStabStrang4 since \|(\pi_{\tau^{-1}}-\pi_N)u^K\|_{L^6}\lesssim N^{-1/2}\|u^K\|_{H^1}. But as written, the displayed recursion is not the error identity of the scheme eq:StrangFully, so the proof of the theorem has a gap.

No change to the theorem statement is needed.
issues.overall_effect: The proof of Theorem ThmStrangFully does not establish the claimed bounds C(\tau^2|\log\tau|+K^{-1}) (\alpha=3) and C(\tau^{3/2}+K^{-1}) (\alpha=4), because the error decomposition it relies on omits two terms. The theorem statement itself is salvageable with the same rates by adding the two missing terms and their estimates; only the numerical discussion refers to this theorem and is unaffected.
issues.title: The error recursion for the fully discrete scheme is not the actual error identity: two terms are missing
issues.why_classification: The final theorem is very likely correct and the missing terms are controllable at the K^{-1} rate, but the proof requires a new decomposition plus two additional estimates; this is a contained repair preserving the statement and all rates, yet more than a typo-level fix.
